name: NovaRender_ReleaseMainWindowOwnerGuarded

name: NovaUi_InitializeFlightViewSurfaces
comment: Deliberate SDL replacement: the QuickDraw/SpriteWorld gameplay surface, 14 ordered SpriteLayer objects, beam layer callbacks, target-FPS setup, and 8/16-bit-depth validation are replaced by the RAII SpaceflightView created on flight entry (src/game/spaceflight.cpp) and its explicit Draw ordering (src/game/spaceflight_view.cpp). The 14-layer chain (ambient stars -> stellars -> asteroids -> disabled ships -> freeflight+fading -> smoke puffs -> shots -> escort ships -> ships -> shots -> impacts -> beams) is decoded and documented in docs/ship_sprite_rendering_path.md; the disabled/escort/normal ship sub-layers are now reproduced in the fixed draw sequence (DrawShipsInLayer), and all four shot containers keep their original layer order: mode9 -> mode1 -> default on layers 7-9, then mode4_alt (weapon mode 4 + owner Flags3 0x0040) on layer 12 (DrawShots(ShotDrawLayer)); the named Ghidra layer globals are g_ambient_star_particle_sprite_layer, g_stellar_sprite_layer, g_asteroid_sprite_layer, g_disabled_ship_sprite_layer, g_freeflight_and_fading_effect_sprite_layer, g_weapon_smoke_puff_sprite_layer, g_shot_container_*, g_escort_ship_sprite_layer, g_ship_sprite_layer, g_impact_effect_sprite_layer, g_beam_sprite_layer. The route-map offscreen frame is replaced by direct RouteMapView drawing; RouteMap_OverlayRect preserves the original top-left square geometry and min-200 side. Its SpriteWorld_InitializeFlightViewSpritePools child remains in progress for separate pool-lifecycle audit.

name: Ship_InitGameplayDataTables
comment: The original bulk-clears fixed-capacity storage that the port represents with value-initialized GameState arrays/vectors and ScenarioData tables; active ship slots are reset by NovaShip_AllocateShipSlot. Its meaningful mission-offering RNG seed is reproduced by Mission_RerollOfferingRolls in the session bootstrap (and fresh-pilot flow). The original Geneva-9/font globals have no port equivalent: NovaFontCache resolves and loads Geneva lazily per UI owner. Remaining QuickDraw-only pool sentinels and startup UI globals are either unobservable in the port or represented by SDL/runtime defaults.

name: NovaGameSession_BuildStartupCurveTable
comment: Builds the 32-entry per-channel 5-bit render lookup table (g_render_brightness_lut, formerly DAT_0085faee) used only by the original 16bpp software blitters: DrawContext_FillRect16 (0x004b6a10), DrawContext_FrameRect16WithCurrentColor (0x004b6ef0), DrawContext_DrawCircleInRect (0x004ba350), FUN_004bb260, SpriteRleCommandStream_ByteSwap (0x00472000), and Resource_LoadPictAsImageWithColorRemap (0x004b8ed0). Entry i = clamp(round((i/31)^(100/param)*31 + 0.5), 0, 31), a gamma-like curve with param = 66.0 + 10.0*brightness (0..6) supplied by NovaGameSession_Run (0x00416100). SDL3 rendering replaces those blitters and the port never consults the table; marker at src/nova_app.cpp NovaGameSession_Run. Divergence: prefs.brightness stays load/save/UI-only and does not alter rendering (no SDL brightness pass).

name: Settings_InitColors
comment: Original Mac symbol _InitColors. Write-once seed of the fixed RGBColor palette (DAT_00733b2c..00733b79); every other reference in the image is a read, so the values are compile-time constants and the SDL port bakes the same 16-bit triples at the draw sites (src/game/radar_panel.cpp, src/game/starmap.cpp, src/game/docked_trade_dialog.cpp, src/game/docked_mission_dialog.cpp, src/game/preferences.cpp) instead of modelling the globals. Slot 5 (DAT_00733b4a, default ship tint) is not written here and remains tracked by the outfit-paint TODO (src/game/outfit.cpp).

name: NovaCommand_TranslateByInputMap
comment: Per-thread bound-key -> command-token table lookup (byte range only) used by the credits label's first-character highlight quirk (NovaUi_DrawCargoMissionStatusPanel) and the same-named 0x004d6230 sibling. The port draws the literal label character and resolves gameplay commands directly through the persisted binding table (src/game/spaceflight.cpp), so the highlight indirection has no runtime call. NOTE: the port's main-menu token mapper was previously misattributed here; it is NovaCommand_DispatchToMode (0x004872a0) in src/nova_app.cpp.

name: FileSystem_IsFile
comment: Win32 GetFileAttributesA file-exists probe (non-directory); port uses std::filesystem::is_regular_file (PilotFileProbeExists).

name: FileSystem_DeleteFileOrDirectory

name: FileSystem_CreateDirectoryRecursive

name: Path_GetDriveVolumeName

name: Resource_OpenFromPath

name: Resource_DeleteFromPath

name: Path_TrimTrailingComponent
comment: Strips the leaf component of a registered Mac path prefix; the port has no runtime path-prefix layer.

name: DebugOptions_GetWord
comment: Reads one word from a 32-short debug/QA option block (resource type 0x91627567 id 0x80, decoded FourCC "ebug", all-zero in the shipped Nova.rez; never written by the binary, likely a leftover Mac developer debug directive of unknown origin, provisionally renamed from FUN_004cd0b0). Its consumers gate loading/reset/pause and seed g_offer_random_bypass_flag; all take the default path, which the port expresses structurally (always load/reset, no AvailRandom bypass). Documented in the Ghidra plate comment. Deliberately skipped.
